race.title: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
race.verdict: THE BEAR TRAP belatedly confirmed the promise of his stable debut effort when capitalising on his reduced mark with a bit to spare over C&D 7 days ago. He could be worth siding with to follow up under a penalty in an open race. Fellow last-time-out winner Pocket Jacks , Jazzy Dancer and Strikepoint are others to consider. THE BEAR TRAP (IRE) POCKET JACKS (IRE) JAZZY DANCER (IRE)
